DitherProgressBar.label: What is in progress. Shown above the bar and used as its accessible name.
DitherProgressBar.value: Progress from 0 to maximum. A negative value makes the bar indeterminate.
DitherProgressBar.maximum: The value that means done, or the capacity when you use parts.
DitherProgressBar.value-text: Text for the readout, such as "3 of 5". Default is the percentage.
DitherProgressBar.hide-label: Hides the label and the readout, but keeps them for screen readers.
DitherProgressBar.color: Colour of the fill and the track.
DitherProgressBar.bloom: low or high adds a glow in the bar's colour.
DitherProgressBar.segments: Cuts the bar into this many blocks, a cell apart. Up to 32.
DitherProgressBar.gap: Colour of the cut between segments. Match the surface behind the bar.
DitherProgressBar.animate: Grows to the value when it appears, eases between values and sweeps the comet.
DitherProgressBar.parts: Several values stacked left to right. Each has label, value, an optional color and an optional fill with custom-fill: true.
DitherProgressBar.unit: Shown after each part's value in the legend, such as " GB".
